name: Urabrask // The Great Work
oracle_text:
First strike
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Urabrask deals 1 damage to target opponent. Add {R}.
{R}: Exile Urabrask, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if you've cast three or more instant and/or sorcery spells this turn.
back_oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)
I — This Saga deals 3 damage to target opponent and each creature they control.
II — Create three Treasure tokens.
III — Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells from any graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).
blocked_sentences: III — Until end of turn, you may cast instant and sorcery spells from any graveyard.
If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.

needs.what: A resolution-time effect op that grants the controller permission, until end of turn, to cast instant and sorcery cards from EVERY player's graveyard (not just their own) — the Yawgmoth's Will / Underworld Breach permission. It must be a floating turn-scoped effect that outlives its source, because the same chapter exiles the Saga immediately afterwards, and it must accept a card-type filter and an owner scope of "any player".
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cast_from_graveyard` exists only in `static_effects`, so it is a permanent static ability read off a permanent that is still on the battlefield; it is not an op a Saga chapter's `effects` list can run, it has no duration, and it dies with the Saga this chapter exiles. `grant_playable` is the closest op, but its `objects` names specific already-known cards (the exile-linked "you may play cards exiled with this" pattern) and its `op_options` are only `any_type`, `limit` and `objects` — no `duration` and no way to say "every card of these types in every graveyard, for the rest of the turn". `exile`'s `playable_this_turn` grants a turn-long cast permission but only for cards this effect itself exiles, and these cards must stay in their graveyards. `grant_ability` grants an ability to objects on the battlefield, so it cannot install a player-scoped permission that survives the source leaving.

needs.what: A replacement effect attached to the above permission: a spell cast under it that would be put into a graveyard from the stack (on resolution or on being countered) is exiled instead. Needs a marker on the spell at cast time and a replacement applied when that spell leaves the stack for a graveyard.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The two replacement ops present, `replace_deaths` and `replace_leaves_battlefield`, both redirect PERMANENTS leaving the battlefield; neither sees a spell moving from the stack to a graveyard. Nothing in `ops` or `static_effects` tags a cast spell so a later zone change can be replaced, and `condition_keys`'s `cast_from_graveyard` is only a yes/no question about how a spell was cast, not a hook that can redirect where it goes afterwards.

notes: Everything else on this card is expressible today and only chapter III blocks it: the front's first strike keyword, its `spell_cast` trigger (damage 1 to a target opponent plus `add_mana`), and its `{R}` ability as an `exile_and_return` to the back face with `sorcery_speed_only` plus a `cmp` on `spells_cast_this_turn` >= 3 filtered to instants and sorceries; on the back, chapter I as damage to a target opponent and their creatures, chapter II as three Treasure tokens, and even chapter III's closing "Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up)" as `exile_and_return` with the front face. Once the two capabilities above land, the whole card can be authored in one pass.
